title.en: A school reform reaches fifty years into the future
title.zh: 一场学制改革，把影响带到五十年后

summary.en: A UK schooling cutoff offers evidence about later dementia diagnoses; the cohort was observed only through age65.
summary.zh: 英国学龄分界为晚年失智诊断提供证据；但随访年龄最高仅65岁。

title.en: Three spacecraft rehearse near Earth before a return to the Moon
title.zh: 三艘飞船先在地球旁排练，再谈重返月球

summary.en: NASA outlines ArtemisIII’s planned2027 docking tests with Blue Origin and SpaceX, ahead of hoped-for2028 lunar landings.
summary.zh: NASA公布ArtemisIII拟于2027年与蓝色起源、SpaceX试验对接，为计划2028年登月做准备。
